newsitem.title: CHILE: Daley meets Chilean economy minister.
newsitem.headline: Daley meets Chilean economy minister.

text.p: U.S. Commerce Secretary William Daley began talks with Chilean Economy Minister Alvaro Garcia in the secretary's first official activity of a three-day visit to Chile.
Daley was due to meet President Eduardo Frei and Finance Minister Eduardo Aninat later Monday.
Accompanied by a group of about 20 American businessmen, Daley arrived on Saturday night and had a private program on Sunday including a visit to a vineyard in the Aconcagua valley outside Santiago.

Daley's main task in Chile will be to convince his skeptical hosts that the Clinton administration is still serious about bringing Chile into the North American Free Trade Agreement, which Chile has been waiting to join since former President George Bush's term.
Daley arrived from Argentina and Brazil and was due to return to Washington on Tuesday.
